title: From Dislocation Mechanics to Continuum Plasticity
exact_target: Derive continuum crystal-plasticity descriptions rigorously from discrete dislocation mechanics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005834 (OWR-14298167-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Multiscale Design of Advanced Materials and Structures (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/11, pp. 657--730. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: This is a programme for deriving models; the source gives no single universal energy or convergence theorem to substitute for it.
